sloka: दुःखानि च बहूनीह ह्यनुभूतानि पार्थिव ।शयानो दुःखशय्यासु नन्दिग्रामे ऽवसत्पुरा ।। ७.६२.१३ ॥
transliteration: duḥkhāni ca bahūnīha hyanubhūtāni pārthiva ।śayāno duḥkhaśayyāsu nandigrāme 'vasatpurā ।। 7.62.13 ॥

translations.english: O King, Bharata indeed experienced many sufferings here, formerly residing in Nandigrama, lying on uncomfortable beds.
